author: Joshua Fluke
description:
They keep saying “nobody wants to work anymore.”

Meanwhile, one job-search example shows roughly 2,000 applications sent, about half ghosted, hundreds rejected, dozens of interviews — and one accepted offer.

And that’s before looking at what some companies now expect applicants to do just to get through the hiring process.

Upload government identification.

Take a selfie for identity verification.

Answer bizarre personality and social questions.

Complete enormous pre-employment assessments.

Talk to an AI recruiter that records and analyzes your responses.

Spend nearly an hour interviewing with a bot.

Apply to jobs that may not even be actively hiring.

Complete 24-hour work trials.

Bring your partner to dinner.

Use two cameras during an interview.

Or spend three to five full days working with a company before they decide whether they actually want to hire you.

Then companies wonder why the hiring process is broken.

title: 24 HOUR WORK TRIALS ARE HERE!
